answer: Mechanism: arrival-shape attestation. Each epoch, the coordinator derives a hidden heartbeat schedule from an opal-signed randomness beacon: signed client pulses must match a target inter-arrival histogram with a prescribed nadir and zephyr-like jitter. The verifier computes pairwise timing correlation and spectral flatness across identities; cloned sybil fleets cluster. To evade, an attacker must give every identity independent clock drift, jitter entropy, and scheduling, reducing throughput and raising compute/ops cost per fake agent.
